note: P1 Thư Đồng (thân cú non chung cho Chấm, Phẩy, Gạch), cao 1,2 m. Cánh dùng xương tay (biên độ thấp), bảng đá cứng trên xương slate (dính liền bụng: chỉ nghiêng tới 30 độ), bút sau lưng là mảnh rời 132 đỉnh trên xương brush cố định (thu về 0,01 khi tay cầm bút P5a). Socket gắn đồ: FX_GLASSES (kính P2a), FX_SCARF (khăn P2b), FX_TAIL (đuôi P3a), FX_WINGBAND_L/R (băng cánh P4a; bên L soi gương x -1), FX_HAND_R (bút P5a, búa P5c), FX_HAND_L (trống P5b), FX_CARRY (túi khi bắt túi). Toạ độ: mét, Z lên, mặt nhìn -Y, +X là tay trái.

clips.name: Helper_Walk
clips.note: bird hop with a light wing flap, 0.42 s per hop: the game moves the body only inside airborne_s (1.67 m per hop at 4.0 m/s)

clips.name: Helper_Walk.carry
clips.note: carrying a bag at FX_CARRY (wings hug it, smaller hops); falls back to Helper_Walk

clips.name: Helper_Assist
clips.note: brush (P5a) in FX_HAND_R flicks chalk strokes onto the slate; the back brush shrinks to 1 % inside the back. Stroke events for the chalk VFX at FX_TOOL

clips.name: Helper_Assist.tower
clips.note: tower group: writes the word on the slate, then lifts it high (slate tilts up 20 deg and the chest leans back 17 deg toward the camera, wings up); falls back to Helper_Assist

clips.name: Helper_Assist.drum
clips.note: Barracks, Keep: drum (P5b) in FX_HAND_L held up in front, the right wing beats it twice per loop; falls back to Helper_Assist

clips.name: Helper_Assist.craft
clips.note: Mine, Farm, Lumber, repairs: mallet (P5c) in FX_HAND_R raised over the shoulder and struck down in front; falls back to Helper_Assist

clips.name: Helper_Assist.support
clips.note: support group (VS: Seal Dais, Apothecary): fans a pot with the left wing, right wing on the hip; falls back to Helper_Assist

clips.name: Helper_Cheer
clips.note: Golden word: hops and flaps both wings over the head twice

clips.name: Helper_Catch
clips.note: catches a falling bag (bag shown at FX_CARRY from the catch event), hugs it, back to Idle; chain into Helper_Walk.carry

clips.name: Helper_Scared
clips.note: panic loop (runs back to the Keep, then trembles 5 s): wings flail at 4 Hz, the body cowers and shakes, the head darts left and right

clips.name: Helper_Hit
clips.note: flinch when a root burst cracks its building (helpers take no damage); then Helper_Scared

clips.name: Helper_Intro
clips.note: slot opening: hops out, chirps with a right-wing wave, bows, back to Idle
